title: Replacement of defective DC solar cables, ACDB, procurement of DCDB and other Electrical items for Navinal Lighthouse and VTS station
summary: GeM bid (BOQ) for refurbishing the 30 kW on-grid solar power system at Navinal Lighthouse and VTS Station, Mundra, Kutch: new DC cabling, DCDBs, ACDB, Delta inverter, replacement PV panels, IoT monitoring, trenching, painting and solar aviation obstruction lights on the 60 m tower.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, VTS Directorate, Gandhidham

sites.name: Navinal VTS & Lighthouse Station, Adani Port Mundra, Dist. Kutch, Gujarat-370421
sites.work: Replacement of solar DC cables, DCDB/ACDB, 30 kW inverter, defective PV panels; IoT monitoring; cable trench, HDPE pipe, markers; painting of solar structure; solar aviation obstruction lights on 60 m tower

scope.item: SITC of 2 in 2 out 1000V DCDB, 32A DC fuse, 1000V SPD, 30A DC MCB, IP67 or better (4 + 2 spare)
SITC of 30KW 3PH ACDB with inbuilt AC MCB 63A, AC SPD 320V, R/Y/B phase indicator, IP65 or better (1 + 1 spare)
SITC of solar DC cables IS 17293:2020, XLPO, TUV, 6 sq.mm red and black, 1.5(1.8) kV DC (6 strings x 300 m + 200 m interconnection + 200 m spare)
SITC of 30KW solar grid inverter (Delta M30A_230 to replace existing Delta RPI M30A_121), 32 kW max DC input, 1100V max DC, 2 MPPT, IP65
Supply of MC4 male/female solar connectors for 6 sq.mm cable, PPO+PA (8 sets of 50 pairs, 400 Nos.)
SITC of solar PV module 250W or more, Class-A, polycrystalline (3 replacement + 3 spare)
Supply of solar MC4 professional crimping tool with MC4 wrench spanner
Supply of AC/DC clamp meter (AC 600V, DC 1000V, AC/DC 1000A or better)
IoT device for monitoring solar generation, compatible with Delta M30A, RS-485/GSM/Wi-Fi, with SIM and 3 years recharge
Supply and laying of 63mm DWC HDPE pipe, ISI marked, IS 14930 Part II, in existing trench
Supply of 63mm UPVC pipe with bends for routing cables to inverter and interconnecting strings
Excavation of cable trenches in soft soil 120m x 0.3m x 0.3m incl. refilling
SITC of solar powered aviation obstruction light, 360 deg high intensity red LED, 12VDC solar input, IP66, SS casing (3 on tower + 1 spare)
SITC of commercial high-pressure washer 2200W, 200-300 bar, min 16L, trolley
Supply of silver grey exterior metallic paint for solar structure frames
Painter hire for painting frames of solar structure
Breaking of RCC road crossing (approx. 3 m) for laying HDPE pipe and reinstatement
Connecting 120 existing solar panels into 6 strings, replacing 3 to 6 defective panels, connecting DC cables to inverter, cable tray
Fixing 4 DCDBs at strings, mounting ACDB, tagging/labelling, sealing pipe openings, 2 painting brushes, any other work
Supply and laying of yellow/red painted RCC cable trench markers 0.3 m, at 2 m spacing (min 50 Nos.)
Fixing of 3 aviation obstruction lights with solar module on top of 60 m tower incl. SS fixing accessories

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (ePBG/FDR), valid 63 months from installation & commissioning
money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all taxes. Original EMD to be submitted at Deep Bhavan, Gandhidham before bid end; EMD exemption only for OEMs (not resellers/traders). Payment 40% on supply, 60% after installation, testing and commissioning. Delay penalty 0.5% per day up to 5%. MII purchase preference 20% (L1+20%), MSE purchase preference L1+15% for 25% quantity.

period.warranty: 5 years for all supplied items and complete 30 kW on-grid solar system including earlier installed panels

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 4 lakh; OEM average turnover (3 years): Rs 25 lakh
3 years past experience for same/similar service; past performance 80% of bid quantity; no MSE/startup relaxation

Similar works in last 7 years: three works >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost (supply/installation/commissioning/maintenance of solar PV systems/inverters/DC cabling) for Central/State Govt/PSU
Not blacklisted (Annexure-III); technical compliance declaration (Annexure-I); brochure with make and model
Local office in Kutch region or within 320 km of Gandhidham
Tender Acceptance Letter (Annexure-II) and site-assessment undertaking (Annexure-IV)
Only Class-I / Class-II local suppliers under Make in India order
specs: Inverter: Delta make model M30A_230 replacing existing Delta RPI M30A_121
Solar DC cable IS 17293:2020 / EN 50618, 6 sq.mm, tin-plated copper, XLPO, 1.5 kV DC; preferred Polycab/KEI/Finolex/RR Kabel
DCDB 1000V, 32A DC fuse, Type-II SPD, 30A DC MCB, IP67; preferred Kenbrook/Kampsol/Accu-Panels/Hensel/Rittal
ACDB 30 kW 3-phase, 63A MCB/MCCB, 320V SPD, MFM, IP65; preferred Kenbrook/Schneider/L&T/ABB/Siemens
PV modules 250W+ Class-A polycrystalline; preferred Adani/Waaree/Vikram/Tata Power Solar
MC4 connectors IP67 PPO+PA; preferred Staubli/Amphenol/Kenbrook/Weidmuller etc.
Clamp meter True-RMS CAT IV 600V/CAT III 1000V; preferred Fluke/Kyoritsu/Hioki
63mm DWC HDPE pipe IS 14930 Part II
Solar aviation obstruction light: red LED 360 deg, IP66, SS-304 housing, min 2 nights autonomy, LED life 50,000 h
High-pressure washer 2200 W, 200-300 bar, 16 L/min, 10 m hose; preferred Karcher/Bosch/Nilfisk etc.
Existing array: 120 panels x 250W in 6 strings of 20, 30 kW Delta inverter, 3-phase ACDB, bi-directional meter (Annexure-V)
notes: GeM bid document (18 pages) followed by buyer ATC with specifications, BoQ and Annexures I-VI; pages 39-40 are a cable layout diagram and a satellite cable-route measurement (109.58 m).
